title: Databases
subtitle: One-click managed databases with a persistent volume.
name: Name
deleteConfirm: Delete this database and its volume? All data is lost. This cannot be undone.
connectionPending: Connection details appear once the database is provisioned.
empty: Spin up Postgres, MySQL, Redis and more in one click.
connectionDesc: Apps on the same server reach this database by its internal host. Keep the credentials secret.
backupsDesc: Dumps are written to the server's disk. Restoring overwrites the current data.
restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? It overwrites the current database.
restoreToConfirm: Pick a compatible database (same engine). This overwrites the target's data.
exportHint: Generate a temporary download link for this S3 backup to import it on another server.
exportExpiry: Link expires in 24 hours — paste it into "Import from URL" on the target database.
exportFailed: Could not generate a migration URL.
importDesc: Restore an external dump (curl'd by the agent) into this database — overwrites current data.
importConfirm: This overwrites the database with the imported dump. Continue?
backupUnsupported: Backups for this engine aren't available yet.
limitsDesc: Optional CPU/memory limits and a container health check. Applied on next provision.
healthCmd: Health check command (e.g. pg_isready -U tugra || exit 1)
publicPortDesc: Expose this database on a host port so external clients can connect. Leave empty for internal-only access.
publicPortInternal: Currently internal-only (reachable by apps on the same network).
provisioningCardBody: Pulling the image and starting the container. Connection details will appear here in a moment.
